goals: Blackfield's strategic objectives appear centered on disrupting targeted organizations to enable ransomware deployment, seeking direct financial gains through ransom payments. The group's limited geographic reach so far— Brazil and Taiwan—may indicate either early-stage expansion or a specific strategic focus on certain regions.
